catalog.name: auth_invitations
catalog.sql: CREATE TABLE auth_invitations (invitation TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, email_address TEXT NOT NULL, invited_at BIGINT NOT NULL)

catalog.name: auth_layout
catalog.sql: CREATE TABLE auth_layout (one_row BOOLEAN NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT TRUE CHECK (one_row), layout INTEGER NOT NULL)

catalog.name: auth_oidc_models
catalog.sql: CREATE TABLE auth_oidc_models (model TEXT NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, grant_id TEXT, uid TEXT, consumed_at BIGINT, expires_at BIGINT, PRIMARY KEY (model, sha256))

catalog.name: auth_people
catalog.sql: CREATE TABLE auth_people (person TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email_address TEXT, joined_at BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, email_verified BOOLEAN)

catalog.name: auth_signing_key
catalog.sql: CREATE TABLE auth_signing_key (one_row BOOLEAN NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT TRUE CHECK (one_row), secret_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL)
